svg.title: Anmar / a question reaches farm data
svg.desc: Private Telegram pilot · deployed boundaries · October 2026 Private Telegram conversation: Linked person and chat, Incoming messages and response delivery. Python worker · Agno · Coolify: Bounded conversation + required domain skills, SQLite: sessions, preferences and delivery state, LiteLLM → model: interpretation and tool selection. Operational tools + integration identity: Credentials and farm scope supplied by code, Anmar Apps issues short-lived access tokens, Separate credentials for Milk and Herd. Anmar operational APIs: Milk: daily records and historical production, Herd: identities, lactation and location, Source authorization, calculations and coverage
